skill.name: nex-single-section-html

skill.summary: Guide an AI agent to create a self-contained HTML hero section with a headline, supporting text, and call to action.
skill.author: nexaiguy

content.value_statement: Simple placeholder pages often require unnecessary project setup. This guide helps an AI agent draft a single HTML hero section without build tools or external dependencies.
actual_capabilities: Guides an AI agent toward a single, self-contained HTML page.
Defines a hero section containing a headline, supporting text, and a call-to-action button.
Describes a centered layout with placeholders for content replacement.
Targets HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript without bundlers or external libraries.
Provides a sample request and an example output location for a generated hero page.
limitations: The folder contains only a public guide; original scripts, extension source, and reusable templates are absent.
The intended output is one hero section, not a complete website or application.
SEO schema, administration features, and advanced visual effects are outside the described scope.
No executable generator or tests are included; output quality depends on the AI agent and requires browser review.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Domain Placeholder
use_cases.description: Draft a single-section page with a project name, short announcement, and contact link for a newly registered domain.

use_cases.title: Present a Hero Layout
use_cases.description: Create a lightweight HTML draft for reviewing headline placement, supporting copy, and a primary call to action with a client.

use_cases.title: Prototype Without a Build Pipeline
use_cases.description: Produce a standalone hero page to evaluate content and layout before integrating the markup into an existing project.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Hero
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a single-file HTML hero for [project name]. Include a headline, brief supporting text, and a contact button linking to [destination].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: start with a simple standalone page.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Coming Soon Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a centered coming soon hero for [product]. Use [headline], [supporting text], and [button label] linking to [URL]. Keep styles inline and dependencies absent.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic customization: supply the page content and destination.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Reusable Placeholder Layout
prompt_templates.prompt: Create one self-contained HTML hero with clearly named placeholders for brand, headline, supporting text, CTA label, and destination. Use HTML5 and CSS3 without external assets.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a layout for repeated content replacement.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Hero for Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a centered HTML hero for [project] using [colors] and supplied copy. Keep CSS self-contained and avoid dependencies. Identify manual integration considerations for [framework].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare standalone markup for later manual integration.

output_examples.input: Create a single-section hero for BeanDrop, a coffee subscription service.
output_examples.output: A standalone HTML page with a centered BeanDrop headline, supporting copy placeholders, and a call-to-action button, following the guide's example.

output_examples.input: Draft a coming soon page for North Studio with a contact button.
output_examples.output: A single HTML document containing the North Studio name, a launch announcement, and a contact link, with styling contained in the file.

best_practices: Provide final headline text, supporting copy, button label, and destination before requesting the page.
Keep the result self-contained and verify that it does not load unnecessary external resources.
Review the generated file in a browser and check placeholder replacement, button destinations, keyboard access, and narrow-screen layout.
anti_patterns: Expecting the public guide to include the original generator scripts or a ready-made template.
Using a single hero section as a substitute for a complete application, administration system, or SEO implementation.
Publishing generated output without checking placeholders, links, and browser rendering.

faq.question: What is included in this skill folder?
faq.answer: Only SKILL.md is included. It describes the intended output but does not contain original scripts, extension source, or templates.

faq.question: Does the generated page require a framework or build step?
faq.answer: The guide targets self-contained HTML5 and CSS3 output without external libraries, preprocessors, or bundlers.

faq.question: Can I create a complete website with this guide?
faq.answer: The described scope is one hero section with a headline, supporting text, and a call-to-action button.

faq.question: Can I use the output with React or Vue?
faq.answer: The guide describes standard HTML that can be manually integrated into another project. It does not provide framework-specific components.

faq.question: Does it include SEO schema or advanced visual effects?
faq.answer: No. SEO schema, administration layers, and advanced effects are outside the scope described in the guide.

faq.question: Will the skill automatically publish my page?
faq.answer: No deployment workflow is provided. Review the generated HTML locally and publish it through your chosen static hosting service.
